data.title: Aseel
data.about:
Welcome to Aseel by Emaar. Located at Arabian Ranches, Aseel offers beautifully crafted duplex Spanish Villas overlooking the Arabian Ranches Golf Course. Find tranquility within the perfect home amidst nature’s best features. Take a walk through the beautiful fairways. At Aseel, your children will have dedicated play areas. You can enjoy an evening stroll through the shaded pathways. Take care of your health at the gym and the fitness centres. Not just that, you can also indulge in self-pampering at the salons and spas. For the spendthrifts, Aseel has the perfect Ranches Souk. The perfect lifestyle awaits you at Aseel.

The homes have the most sophisticated interiors with sleek finishing and refined attachments. When you move into your home at Aseel, it’ll be the perfect castle for you and your family. Aseel is located in Arabian Ranches. It is just minutes away from Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai. It is perfectly connected to the main city and yet located within serenity and peace. If you are a golf enthusiast, Arabian Ranches is your ideal pick. Its 18-hole Championship Golf Course is the perfect place to catch on a game. The Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club is also close by. This is the most coveted place to live with your family and make memories.
